hero.name: Borin

abilities.label: STR
abilities.description: Measures your physical power for lifting, pushing, carrying, and forcing movement. You use it for attacks and tasks that rely on raw muscle.

abilities.label: DEX
abilities.description: Measures your agility, reflexes, and balance. You use it for quick movement, precise actions, and avoiding danger.

abilities.label: CON
abilities.description: Measures your health and stamina. It helps determine your durability and how well you resist effects that strain your body.

abilities.label: INT
abilities.description: Measures your reasoning, memory, and ability to understand complex information. You use it when recalling knowledge, investigating clues, or casting certain spells.

abilities.label: WIS
abilities.description: Your measure of awareness, intuition, and mental resilience. You use it to notice threats, read situations, and resist effects that challenge your mind.

abilities.label: CHA
abilities.description: Measures your force of personality, confidence, and charm. You use it when your presence, influence, or performance matters.

identityDetails.label: Soldier
identityDetails.description: You are trained for battle, gaining proficiency in Athletics and Intimidation. You also gain the Savage Attacker origin feat.

identityDetails.label: Fighter
identityDetails.description: A martial class trained for combat. You rely on Strength or Dexterity for your fighting techniques and have a sturdy Hit Point die.

identityDetails.label: Dwarf
identityDetails.description: A sturdy, Medium folk with a walking speed of 30 feet. You choose this species for its dwarven traits.

hero.proficiencyDescription: A bonus from your total character level. You add it to checks, attacks, saves, and other rolls when you are proficient.

cue.hint: Speak directly to a visible person.

speech.speaker: Aldwin, keeper of the hearth-ledger
speech.text: Aldwin taps the ledger. The cellar is overrun with rats — a giant one, and a swarm in the casks. Clear them and the inn keeps a room for you. 1: The cellar is overrun — I'll clear it. 2: Not today.

speech.speaker: Aldwin, keeper of the hearth-ledger
speech.text: Nothing to record yet, friend. Mira behind the bar will point you at the work.

speech.speaker: Aldwin, keeper of the hearth-ledger
speech.text: As you will. The barrels can wait a day — not two.

speech.speaker: Borin
speech.text: Good morning. What is in the cellar?

events.summary: The turn passes from you to you.
You take 7 damage from Cellar Rat 1 — 4 HP left.
Cellar Rat Swarm's Melee Attack misses you.
